ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to localized clusters and linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black surface. High-contrast white clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips. Dispersed white circular focal points and thin linear vectors are distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute-angle V-shaped depression at the central convergence point of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile; medial trailing edges exhibit low-amplitude peaks, while distal tips exhibit coarse, high-amplitude jagged clusters isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave upward sweep originating from the median notch and terminating at the high-intensity distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white pixel clusters at the lateral extremities of both lobes. Scattered, small-diameter circular white spots visible on the medial surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent curvilinear white mark on the left lobe surface; one distinct vertical linear mark on the right lobe near the median notch; several smaller unaligned linear pixel disruptions across the central ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast scarring or parasitic colonization at the distal tips of both lobes; multiple linear rake-like abrasions on the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of nearly uniform black pigmentation with extreme high-contrast white focal clusters at the fluke tips.
